rule: All written independent finite assertions and direct questions retain exactly one initial resonance
scope_note: Required structure, even in informal chat
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: An answer consisting only of shë/nu is a contextual fragment
scope_note: Both licensed; first fragment, second complete written response
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: Subject omission is licensed only if one immediately salient referent makes it uniquely recoverable
scope_note: Omission cannot be used to hide participants in consent-sensitive utterances
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: dënaro repairs the current speaker’s earlier propositional claim, not a different person’s words
scope_note: A correction requires the newly intended proposition
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: qëlo signals a hearing repair; it does not itself retract the previous claim
scope_note: Keep mishearing separate from claim revision
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: Unanswered invitation or request means no answer, never automatic agreement
scope_note: Evidence cannot be inferred from silence
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: tëshi introduces a new topic only following initial resonance
scope_note: One resonance initial remains obligatory
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: pëshu makes refusal explicitly permissible without asserting agreement
preferred_or_documented_example: më tëqoro ti mi-wa goro ya.
scope_note: Social stance and content are separate
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: hu reports information; it does not establish eyewitness truth
scope_note: Use source distinctions deliberately
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: wëlëmi is paraphrase; qëhano is verbatim quote; never stack on the same span
contrast_or_omission: sen qëhano wëlëmi mi ti-m nashi.
scope_note: Quoted complete clauses still need their own resonance
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: Repeat noun or use name when two possible people could be sa
scope_note: Anaphora must have one salient candidate
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: hë requests information, pëla expresses politeness; resonance cannot assert consent
scope_note: A pleasant attitude is not authorization
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: A short label or answer can omit recoverable structure; a full finite clause cannot drop its resonance
scope_note: Distinguish fragment from incomplete sentence
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: After an explicit correction, quote the earlier form only as superseded
scope_note: Cannot silently rewrite earlier speaker turn
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: An invitation, promise and obligation must remain lexically distinct
scope_note: Future and duty do not imply each other
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: To change resonance, close the independent sentence and begin a new marked one
preferred_or_documented_example: sen mi haro. zha mi goro-yu!
contrast_or_omission: sen mi haro zha mi goro-yu.
scope_note: No mid-sentence marker stacking
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: Bare nu is a fragment, not a complete denial of arbitrary preceding content
scope_note: Use full statement to make the negated proposition clear
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: shurëmi leaves content unresolved; absence of evidence is not affirmative proof
scope_note: Do not upgrade stance to evidence
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: naru includes listener, muru excludes; not interchangeable for commitments
scope_note: Choose group membership intentionally
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection

rule: Rhetorical question frame marks no expected literal answer
scope_note: Do not infer interrogative force solely from punctuation
status: normative usage clarification; no new inflection
